entries.title: A merge card never offers an older version
entries.body: When a crewmate pushes a newer version after its merge card goes up, the card no longer keeps offering the older one. Its Merge button comes off at once, and a line at the top says a newer version was pushed. The same card then shows the newer version and Merge comes back, without a second card for the same change. If another pull request becomes the task's current change, the card says so in the same way.

picture.alt: A merge card whose Merge button is gone, with a line at the top saying a newer version was pushed
